name: Dear my Sweet Devil
source:
It's okay. It's totally okay.

I got up in the morning like always. I went to school like always. I came to the place where she is.

"I'm a devil. I'm..." she says, and our fates are already crossed.
This impossible being, I love her. I am by her always. I want to protect her.
The dream she gave me... and the gentle lie...

In this world without fairy tales or wings, even if you're the cruel
joke of a god who put me in your care... will you give me your kindness?

Dear my Sweet Devil...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077191.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
没关系。完全没问题。

我像往常一样早上起床。我像往常一样去学校。我来到了她所在的地方。

“我是一个魔鬼。我是……”她说，我们的命运已经交叉了。
这个不可能的存在，我爱她。我一直在她身边。我想保护她。
她给我的梦想……还有温柔的谎言……

在这个没有童话，没有翅膀的世界，即使你是残酷的
上帝的笑话，他把我交给你照顾……你能给我你的仁慈吗？

亲爱的我的甜蜜恶魔…

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077191.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
